text.body: brahmamahendrasurendramarudgaṇarudramunīndragaṇairatiramyaṃ kṣīrasaritpatitīramupetya nutaṃ hi satāmavitāramudāram | bhūmibharapraśamārthamatha prathitaprakaṭīkṛtacidghanamūrtim | tvāṃ bhajato raghunandana dehi dayāghana me svapadāmbujadāsyam || 1|| padmadalāyatalocana he raghuvaṃśavibhūṣaṇa deva dayālo nirmalanīradanīlatano'khilalokahṛdambujabhāsaka bhāno | komalagātra pavitrapadābjarajaḥkaṇapāvita gautamakānta | tvāṃ bhajato raghunandana dehi dayāghana me svapadāmbujadāsyam || 2|| pūrṇa parātpara pālaya māmatidīnamanāthamanantasukhābdhe prāvṛḍadabhrataḍitsumanoharapītavarāmbara rāma namaste | kāmavibhañjana kāntatarānana kāñcanabhūṣaṇa ratnakirīṭa | tvāṃ bhajato raghunandana dehi dayāghana me svapadāmbujadāsyam || 3|| divyaśaracchaśikāntiharojjvalamauktikamālaviśālasumaule koṭiraviprabha cārucaritrapavitra vicitradhanuḥśarapāṇe | caṇḍamahābhujadaṇḍavikhaṇḍitarākṣasarājamahāgajadaṇḍam | tvāṃ bhajato raghunandana dehi dayāghana me svapadāmbujadāsyam || 4|| doṣavihiṃsrabhujaṅgasahasrasuroṣamahānalakīlakalāpe janmajarāmaraṇormimaye madamanmathanakravicakrabhavābdhau | duḥkhanidhau ca ciraṃ patitaṃ kṛpayādya samuddhara rāma tato mām | tvāṃ bhajato raghunandana dehi dayāghana me svapadāmbujadāsyam || 5|| saṃsṛtighoramadotkaṭakuñjaratṛṭkṣudanīradapiṇḍitatuṇḍaṃ daṇḍakaronmathitaṃ ca rajastama unmadamohapadojjhitamārtam | dīnamananyagatiṃ kṛpaṇaṃ śaraṇāgatamāśu vimocaya mūḍham | tvāṃ bhajato raghunandana dehi dayāghana me svapadāmbujadāsyam || 6|| janmaśatārjitapāpasamanvitahṛtkamale patite paśukalpe he raghuvīra mahāraṇadhīra dayāṃ kuru mayyatimandamanīṣe | tvaṃ jananī bhaginī ca pitā mama tāvadasi tvavitāpi kṛpālo | tvāṃ bhajato raghunandana dehi dayāghana me svapadāmbujadāsyam || 7|| tvāṃ tu dayālumakiñcanavatsalamutpalahāramapāramudāraṃ rāma vihāya kamanyamanāmayamīśa janaṃ śaraṇaṃ nanu yāyām | tvatpadapadmamataḥ śritameva mudā khalu deva sadāva sasīta | tvāṃ bhajato raghunandana dehi dayāghana me svapadāmbujadāsyam || 8|| yaḥ karuṇāmṛtasindhuranāthajanottamabandhurajottamakārī bhaktabhayormibhavābdhitariḥ sarayūtaṭinītaṭacāruvihārī | tasya raghupravarasya nirantaramaṣṭakametadaniṣṭaharaṃ vai yastu paṭhedamaraḥ sa naro labhate'cyutarāmapadāmbujadāsyam || 9|| || iti śrīmanmadhusūdanāśramaśiṣyācyutayativiracitaṃ śrīsītārāmāṣṭakaṃ sampūrṇam ||
